P_0x002B23: A Shtedonias soldier, a skilled pilot but prone to clashing with superiors, stalling his promotion.
P_0x0066BD: Advisor to <Tesla Leicht Institute>. A Jigen-ryu sword master who helped develop Grungust's blade data. Teacher to Sanger and Brit. Strict on swordplay, easygoing else.
P_0x009F48: A boy who escaped the sealed <Aidoneus Island>. Quiet, few words. Shows rare talent piloting mobile weapons. His past is a mystery.
P_0x00CC05: President of <Earth Fed Gov't>. A hawk on resisting aliens; nicknamed "the Wizard" for looks and backroom skill.
P_0x00EF62: Chairman of <Earth Fed Army> Joint Chiefs, ranked General. Gaspard's right hand. Cautious, bureaucratic - clashed with pragmatic Norman Sley, founder of Earth Sphere Defense Committee.
U_0x001802: Unit 1 of RW Series <Personal Trooper>s from <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-GUN." Once a high-output heavy metal particle cannon, miniaturized and given <Personal Trooper> form to fight solo. Its <Tronium> Engine beats R-2's, with output/firepower above other R units, though unstable. Effectively the 4th R Series unit but never named "R-4," secretly built at <Mao Industries> on the Moon under codename "ARGAN." With plus parts like the back-mounted High Twin Launcher it becomes R-GUN Powered. After the <L5 Campaign>, an improved <T-LINK System> enabled T-LINK Twin Contact with R-3.
U_0x00A1F1: Combined form of Altairlion and Vegalion, newest <Project TD> Series 77 units. Its mobility and agility top every <Armored Module>, with immense firepower.
U_0x00E871: Aerial combat carrier used by <Earth Fed Army> and others. Fighters and <Armored Module>s launch and land in flight; its defenses and armament make it a flying fortress.
